name: Ott's Masterwork
label: Quest
description: Ott is ready to forge a blade for you from fine materials. You are invited to watch his work.
intro: Ott is ready to forge a blade for you from fine materials. You are invited to watch his work.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: These are some truly fine materials, adventurer. You honor me by allowing me to forge this blade for you and I only hope that I can live up to your expectations.
Please, stand back so that I may begin the forging process.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This blade is my finest work and I hope it serves you well in your travels. Thank you again for this opportunity.
